description: Use this when an FPL manager asks their chances (or odds) of winning their mini-league: each manager's win and top-3 probability from 5,000 simulations of the rest of the season.

league_id.description: Mini-league ID, or the FPL league standings link. Leave empty to list the manager's leagues.
league_id.title: League Id

team_id.description: The manager's FPL team ID (entry ID), or any FPL link containing /entry/<id>/. Leave empty if unknown.
team_id.title: Team Id

name: get_mini_league_odds
title: FPL mini-league win chances
